parallel.description: When true, Pablo dispatches Bob and Susan tasks concurrently for each component rather than sequentially. Reduces total run time for large component sets.

dryRun.description: When true, Pablo identifies scope and reports which components would be targeted and which tests would be regenerated, without invoking Susan for execution.

skipSmoke.description: When true, Pablo skips the Smoke pre-flight step and proceeds directly to API-Agent and Bob. Use only when you know the build is clean. Default: false.

skipE2e.description: When true, Pablo does not pass e2e configuration through to Susan, so the real Playwright suite is not executed. Use when no application build is available. Default: false.

e2eRoot.description: Overrides the adapter's e2eRoot. Directory containing playwright.config.* for the target project.

e2eCommand.description: Overrides the adapter's e2eCommand. Defaults to 'npm run test:e2e'.

e2eBrowsers.description: Playwright project names to execute (e.g. chromium, firefox, webkit). Omit to run every project defined in playwright.config.

abortOnSmokeFailure.description: When true (default), Pablo aborts the run if Smoke reports any critical or high finding. Set to false to continue despite smoke failures (results will be marked as at-risk).

webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTP/S URL to POST a run-summary payload to on completion. Used for Slack or other webhook integrations.
